name: Galwan Valley Clash (2020)
description: Deadliest India-China clash since 1967. Hand-to-hand combat at 14,000 feet resulting in 20 Indian deaths including Colonel Santosh Babu. Opens 'China as second adversary' thread for Dhurandhar universe.
location: Galwan Valley, Ladakh (Line of Actual Control)

background.context: Ongoing standoff since May 2020; China objected to Indian road construction near LAC

incident.trigger: Indian CO Colonel Babu went to remove Chinese tent erected in disengagement zone
incident.escalation: PLA troops ambushed; reinforcements arrived; hand-to-hand combat with improvised weapons (metal rods, clubs, barbed wire-wrapped sticks)
incident.casualties: 20 Indian soldiers killed; 76 injured; Chinese casualties disputed (claimed 4; estimates 35-45)

indian_martyrs.colonel_santosh_babu: CO 16 Bihar; Maha Vir Chakra (posthumous); killed attempting de-escalation then fighting
indian_martyrs.others: Havildar Palani, Sepoy Gurunathan, etc. — hand-to-hand combat deaths

strategic_significance.china_front: Establishes China as secondary adversary in Dhurandhar universe
strategic_significance.tactical_change: No firearms per LAC agreements; brutal hand-to-hand combat
strategic_significance.aftermath: Massive troop buildup; Ladakh militarization; infrastructure race

film_relevance.part_4: Opening act; China adversary introduction; Santosh Babu sacrifice centerpiece
film_relevance.visual_element: High-altitude combat; night fighting; primitive weapons at 14,000ft
